question: What change in intercalation energy does the DFT give and at what in-plane strain, what potential change was measured and at what in-plane prestrain, and what is the ratio of computed to measured change?
rendered: The DFT calculations show a change in intercalation energy of ∼75 meV (∼75 mV) at an applied in-plane strain of +1.5% on the V2O5 lattice. The measured change in potential of ∼40 mV was observed at about ∼1.66% in-plane prestrain. The ratio of the computed to measured change is ∼1.88 (∼75 mV / ∼40 mV).
